items.title: Barzilay and Collins receive 2026 Pritzker Prize for AI in Science Research Excellence
items.summary_en: A web-search snippet says MIT's Regina Barzilay and James Collins received the 2026 Pritzker Prize for AI in Science Research Excellence, for AI-enabled antibiotic discovery. I could not open the article, so details are unverified.
items.source_name: MIT News (CSAIL topic listing page, via search snippet)
items.notes: Direct fetch blocked (news.mit.edu and www.csail.mit.edu do not resolve in this session). Based only on a search-result summary. The URL is a topic listing page, not the article. items.title: MIT CSAIL Agentic AI Summit featured Hadfield-Menell, Williams and Andreas
items.summary_en: The CSAIL Alliances events page lists an Agentic AI Summit on Nov 9. It featured a keynote by Dylan Hadfield-Menell, talks by Brian Williams and Jacob Andreas, and an industry panel. This is an event listing, not a results report.
items.source_name: CSAIL Alliances event page (via search result)
items.notes: Event listing only. No recording or slides were found. The page may be members-only, so do not scrape it. The search tool noted the CSAIL FORUM on Nov 17 (Daniel Jackson on agentic software development) as an upcoming event.

items.title: Fortune reports CSAIL research: frontier model can understand and fine-tune another model without specialized training
items.summary_en: According to a search-result summary, Fortune reported on CSAIL research showing that a large frontier model can understand and fine-tune another model's capabilities without specialized training. This is a media report, not the CSAIL primary source.
items.source_name: MIT News In the Media (via search snippet; original is Fortune)
items.notes: Secondary only. The Fortune URL and the underlying paper were not seen. The date is before the window. Locate the primary CSAIL release or preprint before use.

coverage_note: Partial coverage. Direct fetches of www.csail.mit.edu and news.mit.edu failed (hosts not resolvable). Both would need to be added to the session's allowed network domains. I could not open any CSAIL press release, paper or preprint. Every item rests on search-result snippets pointing at listing pages. Their titles, dates and attribution to CSAIL are unverified, and no article-level URLs were found. The Liquid AI/Mercedes story (WSJ, Nov 5) was also in the results. I left it out because it is about a spinout, not CSAIL's own publication. Treat all items as leads to confirm, not as citable facts, until the primary pages can be fetched.
